matrix_name.name: polycarbonate
matrix_name.description: Makrolon 2805; composite with reflection-absorption-integrated shielding compartments assembled from polycarbonate microspheres (CFP-4).

fillers.name: carbon nanotubes
fillers.description: NC7000 carbon nanotubes (average diameter 9.5 nm, length 1.5 μm); located on the microsphere surface to form conductive walls.

fillers.name: reduced graphene oxide/iron(II,III) oxide
fillers.description: RGF hybrid filler dispersed inside the shielding compartments; Fe3O4 nanoparticles (~10 nm) deposited on reduced graphene oxide, with Fe3O4 about 80 wt% of the hybrid.

matrix_name.name: polycarbonate
matrix_name.description: Makrolon 2805; comparison composite with randomly dispersed fillers (r-CFP-4).

fillers.name: carbon nanotubes
fillers.description: NC7000 carbon nanotubes (average diameter 9.5 nm, length 1.5 μm); randomly dispersed conductive filler.

fillers.name: reduced graphene oxide/iron(II,III) oxide
fillers.description: RGF hybrid filler randomly dispersed in the matrix; Fe3O4 nanoparticles deposited on reduced graphene oxide.
